description: Lazy batching, sliding windows, dedupe and grouping over iterables

signatures.name: batched
signatures.doc: Consecutive lists of at most `size`. The final batch may be shorter.

signatures.name: windowed
signatures.doc: Sliding windows of exactly `size`. Yields nothing if the input is shorter.

signatures.name: dedupe
signatures.doc: First occurrence wins, original order preserved.

signatures.name: chunk_by
signatures.doc: Group consecutive items sharing a key. Does not sort first.

signatures.name: take
signatures.doc: First n items, without consuming more of the source than needed.
